comment: PolyMarket: apps PolyOS offers to install. Only these can be installed through polyos-admin. source=debian installs Debian packages with apt; source=flathub installs from Flathub. 'desktop' lists the launcher ids to open after installing; 'icons' are icon-theme names tried in order. 'packs' are the Gaming and Developer editions: sets of these apps installed together (true = picked by default). 'arches' limits an app to those processor types (amd64: Intel/AMD PCs; arm64); without it the app is offered on both.

apps.name: Firefox
apps.summary: Fast, private web browser from Mozilla.
apps.description: Firefox ESR from Mozilla: tracking protection, sync across devices and thousands of add-ons.

apps.name: Chromium
apps.summary: The open-source browser behind Google Chrome.
apps.description: Chromium runs Chrome web apps and extensions, without Google's own services built in.

apps.name: Google Chrome
apps.summary: Google's browser, with sign-in and sync.
apps.description: The browser PolyOS ships with. Sign in with your Google account to bring your bookmarks, passwords and extensions from your other computers.

apps.name: Brave
apps.summary: Privacy browser that blocks ads and trackers.
apps.description: Brave blocks ads and trackers by default and runs Chrome extensions.

apps.name: Discord
apps.summary: Voice, video and text chat with friends.
apps.description: Hang out in servers, voice channels and DMs with your friends and communities.

apps.name: Telegram
apps.summary: Fast messaging that syncs across devices.
apps.description: Chats, groups and channels that stay in sync with your phone.

apps.name: Signal
apps.description: Link Signal to your phone to send encrypted messages and calls from your computer.

apps.name: Zoom
apps.description: Join and host video meetings, share your screen and chat.

apps.name: Thunderbird
apps.description: Read all your email accounts in one place, with a calendar and address book.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.description: Stream music and podcasts, and pick up where you left off on your phone.

apps.name: VLC
apps.summary: Plays almost any video or music file.
apps.description: VLC plays nearly every video and audio format, DVDs and network streams.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.summary: Record your screen and stream live.
apps.description: Record and stream with scenes, webcams, audio mixing and transitions.

apps.name: Audacity
apps.description: Record voice-overs and podcasts, cut and mix tracks, and clean up noise.

apps.name: Kdenlive
apps.description: Edit videos on a multi-track timeline with effects, titles and transitions.

apps.name: Steam
apps.summary: Thousands of games, many of them for Linux.
apps.description: Buy and play games. Proton runs many Windows games on PolyOS too.

apps.name: Prism Launcher
apps.summary: Play Minecraft: Java Edition with mods.
apps.description: Sign in with your Microsoft account to play Minecraft: Java Edition, with easy mod packs.

apps.name: Heroic Games Launcher
apps.description: Play the games you own on the Epic Games Store, GOG and Amazon.

apps.name: SuperTuxKart
apps.description: Race against friends or the computer on dozens of tracks.

apps.name: LibreOffice
apps.description: Writer, Calc and Impress open and save Word, Excel and PowerPoint files.

apps.name: ONLYOFFICE
apps.summary: Office suite that looks like Microsoft Office.
apps.description: Edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files with a familiar ribbon layout.

apps.name: Obsidian
apps.description: Take notes in Markdown files and connect ideas with links and graphs.

apps.name: Calculator
apps.description: Everyday math, scientific functions, unit and currency conversion.

apps.name: Document Viewer
apps.summary: Open PDFs and fill in forms.
apps.description: Read PDFs, search them and fill in PDF forms.

apps.name: GIMP
apps.description: Retouch photos, paint and make graphics with layers, masks and filters.

apps.name: Krita
apps.description: Digital painting with brush engines, drawing tablet support and animation.

apps.name: Inkscape
apps.description: Design logos, icons, posters and diagrams as scalable SVG.

apps.name: Blender
apps.description: Model, sculpt, animate and render in 3D, and edit video.

apps.name: OpenSCAD
apps.description: Design precise, parametric parts for 3D printing by writing a short script. Vara can write and render them for you.

apps.name: FreeCAD
apps.description: Design mechanical parts and assemblies with sketches and constraints, and export STEP or STL.

apps.name: KiCad
apps.summary: Circuit boards, from schematic to PCB.
apps.description: Draw schematics, lay out printed circuit boards and make the files a PCB factory needs.

apps.name: PrusaSlicer
apps.description: Slice STL and 3MF models into G-code for Prusa and many other 3D printers.

apps.name: Arduino IDE
apps.description: Write sketches, install board support and libraries, upload to your board and watch the serial monitor.

apps.name: UltiMaker Cura
apps.description: Prepare models for UltiMaker and hundreds of other 3D printers, with recommended settings built in.

apps.name: TurboWarp
apps.summary: Scratch, but faster. Where PolyOS began.
apps.description: Build and run Scratch projects offline, with a compiler that makes them much faster.

apps.name: Visual Studio Code
apps.description: Edit code in any language, with extensions, Git and a built-in terminal.

apps.name: Git
apps.description: Track changes to your code and work with GitHub. Use it from the Terminal.

apps.name: Node.js
apps.summary: JavaScript outside the browser, with npm.
apps.description: Run JavaScript and install packages with npm. Use it from the Terminal.

apps.name: Python libraries
apps.summary: NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, pandas and more, ready to import.
apps.description: The libraries most Python projects reach for: maths and science (NumPy, SciPy), charts (Matplotlib), data (pandas), the web (requests), serial ports for Arduino and robots (pyserial), images (Pillow) and YAML.

apps.name: Docker
apps.summary: Run apps and services in containers.
apps.description: Docker and Docker Compose. You're added to the docker group, so it works without sudo after you sign out and in again.

apps.name: Geany
apps.description: A quick editor with syntax highlighting, a file browser and build commands.

apps.name: Timeshift
apps.description: Take snapshots of the system and roll back if an update or change breaks something.

apps.name: KeePassXC
apps.summary: Password manager that stays on your PC.
apps.description: Keep your passwords in an encrypted file only you can open.

apps.name: Bitwarden
apps.description: Store passwords in your Bitwarden vault and use them on every device.

apps.name: LocalSend
apps.summary: Send files to nearby phones and PCs.
apps.description: Share files with phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi, no cable or account needed.

apps.name: Disks
apps.summary: Format USB drives and check disks.
apps.description: Format and name drives, check disk health and write disk images.

apps.name: Printers
apps.description: Set up network and USB printers.

apps.name: Bottles (Wine)
apps.summary: Run Windows apps and games with Wine.
apps.description: Bottles sets up Wine for you: install a Windows game or app into its own bottle, with the right runner and fixes, and play it from PolyOS.

apps.name: Lutris
apps.summary: All your games in one library.
apps.description: Install and play games from Battle.net, EA, Ubisoft, GOG, emulators and more with community install scripts.

apps.name: ProtonUp-Qt
apps.summary: Newer Proton and Wine versions for Steam and Lutris.
apps.description: Add community builds like Proton-GE, which fix many Windows games in Steam, Lutris and Heroic.

apps.name: GameMode
apps.summary: Gives games the computer's full speed while they run.
apps.description: Feral's GameMode: games that ask for it (and Steam with “gamemoderun %command%”) get the processor's performance mode and priority.

apps.name: Build tools
apps.summary: Compilers, Python pip and venv, and command-line tools (installed with PolyOS).
apps.description: GCC, make, Python venv and pip, curl, wget and jq: what most coding projects expect to find. PolyOS comes with them.

gaming.name: Gaming
gaming.summary: Steam, Windows games with Wine, game launchers and Game Mode.

developer.name: Developer
developer.summary: Git, Python with pip and its main libraries, Node.js, VS Code and Docker; Blender and OpenSCAD if you want them.
